newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Argentine 96/97 wheat crop 16.10 mln tonnes-Safras.
newsitem.headline: Argentine 96/97 wheat crop 16.10 mln tonnes-Safras.

text.p: Argentine wheat production in 1996/97 (November/October) is now seen at 16.10 million tonnes, up from a forecast of 15.80 million tonnes in April, said independent consultants Safras e Mercado.
Exports during the period are estimated at 11.10 million tonnes, a sharp rise on the 4.4 million tonnes sold abroad in 1995/96 when production reached only 9.45 million tonnes.
For the 1997/98 season, Safras estimates that planted area could fall 10 percent to 6.6 million hectares from 7.3 million in 1996.
With average yields over the past five years of 2,142 kgs per hectare, production could reach 14.2 million tonnes, a drop of 12 percent on 1996/97.
As a result, exports are also seen lower at 9.2 million tonnes, Safras said.
